ingredients.notes: All ingredients use edible gram weights. Allergen disclosures and the new illustration were checked against the ingredient list.

method.notes: Stovetop rice ratio scaled from 300 g dry Japanese rice and 400 ml water. Pan-crisped plain onigiri are finished briefly with a thin light-miso coating. Four triangles, two per serving. AFCD F007682 is a white long-grain rice proxy for Japanese short-grain rice. The Japanese MEXT 01083 starch-and-sugar total of 75.6 g per 100 g bounds the difference from the 74.0 g AFCD estimate. AFCD F005702 is a light-miso proxy. The estimate counts all pan oil and makes no measured-loss adjustment.

food_safety.notes: Cook the rice through and serve promptly. Chill leftovers within one hour and use within 24 hours.

servings_and_time.notes: 2 portions with 60 minutes including the specified cooking and resting or cooling periods.
